The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-20, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#534). One arm, shipped harness/borg.txt, no
parameter overrides, /stopscared off; classes-18 at 100,000 turns (18 games). A trace and pipeline check.
Gate: one binary; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; full raw trace-core.jsonl and summary.json
retained for every cell, survivors included, with seed, race and class; death_risk present on every traced think
with F1-F3, the fit features and stop_eligible; missing or failed cells reported explicitly; natural deaths kept as
ordinary Cemetery evidence. The calibration tool and its metrics (Brier, log loss, AUC, reliability by decile,
first-stop and final-window crossings) are the borg-reborn-rs session's, run on the retained shards. Report the
counts of distinct death-bearing starts per split so that a larger tier can be asked for.
experiment.question: Does borg-reborn-rs 5343532c (task/T790-death-risk) write the per-think death_risk observations on every traced think of every cell, so that the calibration tool (tools/calibrate-death-risk.py) has traces to score?
